QF.id: XC Investment Products and Market Developments_1

question.text: Under SEBI regulations, a Portfolio Management Service (PMS) requires a minimum investment of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Series X-A states that a portfolio manager shall not accept funds or securities worth less than Rs.50 lakh from a client. This minimum ensures PMS is offered only to investors with the financial capacity and risk tolerance the product assumes. The Trap: Rs.1 crore is the per-investor AIF minimum, not PMS. Rs.10 lakh is below any regulated threshold for either product. Note: Clients who do not meet the Rs.50 lakh PMS threshold can access professional management through mutual funds, which have no comparable minimum.
